items.Sentence: The existing WWTF consists of a wet well lift station, eight wastewater stabilization ponds on approximately 20 acres and a 31.5-acre spreading basin.
The remainder will continue to be used as land spreading area when needed.
The WWTF treatment and disposal capacity will be increased by converting part of the existing 31.5-acre land spreading area to two percolation/evaporation ponds (Ponds 9 and 10).
